#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long modInv(long long value) {
    long long g = MOD;
    long long x = 0;
    long long y = 1;
    long long r = value;
    while (r != 0) {
        long long q = g / r;
        g %= r;
        swap(g, r);
        x -= q * y;
        swap(x, y);
    }
    long long res = x % MOD;
    if (res < 0) res += MOD;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    if (n == 0) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        p = p * (n - i + 1) % MOD;
        p = p * modInv(n + m - i + 1) % MOD;
        phaseSize += p;
        if (phaseSize >= MOD) phaseSize -= MOD;
    }

    long long harmonic = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        harmonic += modInv(i);
        if (harmonic >= MOD) harmonic -= MOD;
    }

    long long inner = (1 + ((long long)m % MOD) * harmonic) % MOD;
    long long answer = phaseSize * inner % MOD;
    cout << answer << endl;

    return 0;
}
